45:         <div><span class="story-no">Story 02 · Dream tale</span></div>
46:         <h1>The Dream Beyond <span class="accent">The Shadows</span></h1>
47:         <p class="read-lede">For three nights, a little dreamer has not slept. Two guardians step through a star portal into a hallway that will not hold still — and tell the dark a better story. A bedtime-sized rescue in three scenes.</p>
48:         <ul class="read-meta" aria-label="Story details">
49:           <li>3 scenes</li>
50:           <li>~4 min read</li>
51:           <li>From: Hexa Baby, Dream Guardians</li>
52:         </ul>
53:       </header>
54: 
55:       <figure class="read-banner">
56:         <div class="banner-frame banner-dream">
57:           <img src="Assets/img/TogetherNoBg.png" alt="The two friends standing together, ready to enter the dream" width="240" height="170" fetchpriority="high" />
58:         </div>
59:         <figcaption>The guardians, moments before the portal opens.</figcaption>
60:       </figure>
61: 
62:       <article class="read-article">
63:         <section class="read-scene" aria-labelledby="sc1-h">
64:           <div class="scene-head"><span class="scene-index" aria-hidden="true">01</span><h2 id="sc1-h">The Dreamer Who Stopped</h2></div>
65:           <p class="scene-setting">Three nights without sleep</p>
66:           <p>For three nights in a row, Hexa Baby had not slept. Every time sleep came, the shadows came with it — long, quiet shapes that filled the room and swallowed the light.</p>
67:           <p>Abhay and Divyansh noticed immediately, the way astronomers notice a star going out.</p>
68:           <p class="line-dialogue"><strong>Divyansh:</strong> “A nightmare has trapped him inside. If we don't go in, he'll never fall asleep again.”</p>
69:           <p>They packed the lantern, the staff, and a story to spare, and stepped toward the star portal — a door of light hanging in the air, patient as only a door can be.</p>
70:         </section>
71: 
72:         <section class="read-scene" aria-labelledby="sc2-h">
73:           <div class="scene-head"><span class="scene-index" aria-hidden="true">02</span><h2 id="sc2-h">Inside The Nightmare</h2></div>
74:           <p class="scene-setting">The hallway with no end</p>
75:           <p>The dream world was a hallway of shadows that moved when nobody watched. Every corner they turned, the exit shifted — politely, at first, then with something almost like mischief.</p>
76:           <p>The shadow was not attacking. It was simply afraid, the way Hexa Baby was afraid, wearing the same coat in a bigger size.</p>
77:           <figure class="scene-art">
78:             <div class="scene-frame banner-dream">
79:               <img src="Assets/img/icons/bat trans.png" alt="A bat gliding through the dream hallway" width="120" height="96" loading="lazy" />
80:             </div>
81:             <figcaption>Something small and scared was flying ahead of them.</figcaption>
82:           </figure>
83:           <p class="line-dialogue"><strong>Abhay:</strong> “Remember the rule. The dream is only frightened.”</p>
84:           <p class="line-dialogue"><strong>Divyansh:</strong> “So am I. Frightened things listen when you talk softly.”</p>
85:           <p>So Divyansh knelt and began to tell a story — not a scary one, but a small tale about a light that had never learned it was allowed to stay. The shadows slowed. For the first time, they listened.</p>
86:         </section>
87: 
88:         <section class="read-scene" aria-labelledby="sc3-h">
89:           <div class="scene-head"><span class="scene-index" aria-hidden="true">03</span><h2 id="sc3-h">Beyond The Shadows</h2></div>
90:           <p class="scene-setting">A sky with no stars</p>
91:           <p>They found Hexa Baby curled beneath a sky with no stars, knees pulled up, making himself as small as fear knows how.</p>
92:           <p>Abhay raised the lantern until the light lay gently on the floor, and Divyansh finished the story — and the shadows uncurled like paper in warm water. Behind them, the exit was finally standing still.</p>
93:           <figure class="scene-art">
94:             <div class="scene-frame banner-dream">
95:               <img src="Assets/img/icons/sparkle-lavender.svg" alt="A lavender sparkle, like a small star returning" width="90" height="90" loading="lazy" />
96:             </div>
97:             <figcaption>The first star of many, coming back.</figcaption>
98:           </figure>
99:           <p class="line-dialogue"><strong>Hexa Baby:</strong> “Did the dark go away?”</p>
100:           <p class="line-dialogue"><strong>Divyansh:</strong> “No. It just became a hallway. Hallways have ends.”</p>
101:           <p>Walking back, Hexa Baby held both their hands. The nightmare did not disappear that night — it stopped being the whole world. He slept that night, and the next, and every night after; and on the worst of those nights, he dreamed of a lantern first.</p>
102:         </section>
103:       </article>
